visualCharacteristics: Our Heritage: interactive horizontal timeline. Prominent top timeline bar with clickable year buttons (18 entries); clicking a year activates its slide (image, title, description). Active year highlighted, bar progress indicator, prev/next. Active slide centered and enlarged, neighbours visible on either side.
contentPattern: One row per milestone: image | richtext with year (p or h3, a bare 3-4 digit year), title (heading or bold paragraph), description paragraph(s). A separate year cell is also accepted.
